_note: Editable. Each metric is scored 0 to 10 by a straight line between `worst` (0) and `best` (10); an area is the weighted mean of its metrics that have data. Thresholds and weights were set so the baseline window lands near the earlier judgment ratings (`original`); where it does not, the page says why. After that the TREND matters more than the absolute number.
